CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_data_overview()
 RETURNS TABLE(total_catalogs integer, total_sightings integer, total_mantas integer, total_photos integer, avg_sightings_per_catalog numeric, min_sightings_per_catalog integer, max_sightings_per_catalog integer, avg_mantas_per_sighting numeric, min_mantas_per_sighting integer, max_mantas_per_sighting integer, avg_photos_per_manta numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  select
    -- Basic counts
    (select count(*) from catalog) as total_catalogs,
    (select count(*) from sightings) as total_sightings,
    (select count(*) from mantas) as total_mantas,
    (select count(*) from photos) as total_photos,

    -- Sightings per Catalog
    (select coalesce(avg(count), 0) from (
      select count(*) as count
      from mantas
      where fk_catalog_id is not null
      group by fk_catalog_id
    ) as sub) as avg_sightings_per_catalog,
    
    (select coalesce(min(count), 0) from (
      select count(*) as count
      from mantas
      where fk_catalog_id is not null
      group by fk_catalog_id
    ) as sub) as min_sightings_per_catalog,
    
    (select coalesce(max(count), 0) from (
      select count(*) as count
      from mantas
      where fk_catalog_id is not null
      group by fk_catalog_id
    ) as sub) as max_sightings_per_catalog,

    -- Mantas per Sighting
    (select coalesce(avg(count), 0) from (
      select count(*) as count
      from mantas
      where fk_sighting_id is not null
      group by fk_sighting_id
    ) as sub) as avg_mantas_per_sighting,

    (select coalesce(min(count), 0) from (
      select count(*) as count
      from mantas
      where fk_sighting_id is not null
      group by fk_sighting_id
    ) as sub) as min_mantas_per_sighting,

    (select coalesce(max(count), 0) from (
      select count(*) as count
      from mantas
      where fk_sighting_id is not null
      group by fk_sighting_id
    ) as sub) as max_mantas_per_sighting,

    -- Photos per Manta
    (select coalesce(avg(count), 0) from (
      select count(*) as count
      from photos
      where fk_manta_id is not null
      group by fk_manta_id
    ) as sub) as avg_photos_per_manta;
$function$
applicationDefinitions.result: TABLE(total_catalogs integer, total_sightings integer, total_mantas integer, total_photos integer, avg_sightings_per_catalog numeric, min_sightings_per_catalog integer, max_sightings_per_catalog integer, avg_mantas_per_sighting numeric, min_mantas_per_sighting integer, max_mantas_per_sighting integer, avg_photos_per_manta numeric)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_mantas_by_vector(query_embedding vector, match_threshold double precision, match_count integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(catalog_id integer, name text, score double precision, thumb_url text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  select
    m.fk_catalog_id                       as catalog_id,
    c.name,
    1 - (e.embedding <=> query_embedding) as score,   -- cosine similarity
    p.thumbnail_url
  from photo_embeddings e
  join photos            p on p.id           = e.photo_id
  join mantas            m on m.pk_manta_id  = p.fk_manta_id
  join catalog           c on c.pk_catalog_id = m.fk_catalog_id
  where p.is_best_catalog_ventral_photo
        and (e.embedding <=> query_embedding) < match_threshold
  order by e.embedding <=> query_embedding
  limit match_count;
end;
$function$
applicationDefinitions.result: TABLE(catalog_id integer, name text, score double precision, thumb_url text)
applicationDefinitions.args: query_embedding vector, match_threshold double precision, match_count integer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_manta(_query_embedding vector, _match_threshold real DEFAULT 0.30, _match_count integer DEFAULT 10, _side text DEFAULT 'ventral'::text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_manta_to_catalog(match_limit integer, match_offset integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(fk_manta_id integer, true_catalog_id integer, matched_catalog_id integer, score double precision, is_true_match boolean, rank integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  select
    me.fk_manta_id,
    m.fk_catalog_id as true_catalog_id,
    ce.pk_catalog_id as matched_catalog_id,
    1 - (me.embedding <=> ce.embedding) as score,
    (ce.pk_catalog_id = m.fk_catalog_id) as is_true_match,
    rank() over (
      partition by me.fk_manta_id
      order by me.embedding <=> ce.embedding asc
    )::integer as rank
  from manta_embeddings me
  join mantas m on me.fk_manta_id = m.pk_manta_id
  join catalog_embeddings ce on ce.embedding is not null
  where me.embedding is not null
  order by me.fk_manta_id, rank
  limit match_limit
  offset match_offset;
end;
$function$
applicationDefinitions.result: TABLE(fk_manta_id integer, true_catalog_id integer, matched_catalog_id integer, score double precision, is_true_match boolean, rank integer)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_catalog_embeddings(query_embedding real[], match_count integer, match_threshold real)
 RETURNS TABLE(pk_catalog_id integer, score real)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with q as (
    select query_embedding::vector as qv
  ),
  ranked as (
    select
      c.pk_catalog_id,
      (ce.embedding <#> q.qv) * -1 as score  -- cosine distance to similarity (negated distance)
    from catalog c
    join catalog_embeddings ce on ce.catalog_id = c.catalog_uuid
    cross join q
    where ce.embedding is not null
  )
  select pk_catalog_id, score
  from ranked
  where score >= match_threshold
  order by score desc
  limit greatest(match_count, 1)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fix_missing_catalog_photo(input_catalog_id integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  chosen int;
begin
  -- prefer flagged best ventral
  select pk_photo_id into chosen
  from photos
  where fk_catalog_id = input_catalog_id
    and photo_view = 'ventral'
    and is_best_catalog_ventral_photo is true
  order by pk_photo_id asc
  limit 1;

  -- else fall back to most recent ventral
  if chosen is null then
    select pk_photo_id into chosen
    from photos
    where fk_catalog_id = input_catalog_id
      and photo_view = 'ventral'
    order by uploaded_at desc nulls last, pk_photo_id desc
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if chosen is not null then
    update catalog
       set best_cat_ventral_id = chosen,
           best_cat_mask_ventral_id_int = chosen
     where pk_catalog_id = input_catalog_id;
    -- triggers should set best_catalog_photo_url
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_best_catalog_ventral_flag()
 RETURNS trigger

AS $function$
begin

  update public.photos
     set is_best_catalog_ventral_photo = null
   where fk_catalog_id = new.pk_catalog_id

  -- Set the chosen photo as the new best (if pointer present)
  if new.best_cat_mask_ventral_id_int is not null then

     where pk_photo_id = new.best_cat_mask_ventral_id_int;

end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.merge_catalogs_preview(p_primary integer, p_secondary integer, p_delete_secondary_if_detached boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
with ids as (
  select least(p_primary,p_secondary) as primary,
         greatest(p_primary,p_secondary) as secondary
),
counts as (
  select
    -- rows currently tied directly to the secondary
    (select count(*) from public.photos  where fk_catalog_id = ids.secondary) as photos_moved,
    (select count(*) from public.mantas  where fk_catalog_id = ids.secondary) as mantas_moved,
    -- photos that would be backfilled via mantas linked to the primary
    (select count(*)
       from public.photos p
      where (p.fk_catalog_id is distinct from ids.primary or p.fk_catalog_id is null)
        and p.fk_manta_id in (select pk_manta_id from public.mantas where fk_catalog_id = ids.primary)
    ) as photos_via_mantas_moved,
    -- prospective summaries if your catalog has those fields
    (select min(s.sighting_date)
       from public.mantas m
       left join public.sightings s on s.pk_sighting_id = m.fk_sighting_id
      where m.fk_catalog_id in (ids.primary, ids.secondary)
    ) as new_first_sighting,
    (select max(s.sighting_date)
       from public.mantas m
       left join public.sightings s on s.pk_sighting_id = m.fk_sighting_id
      where m.fk_catalog_id in (ids.primary, ids.secondary)
    ) as new_last_sighting,
    (select count(distinct m.fk_sighting_id)
       from public.mantas m
      where m.fk_catalog_id in (ids.primary, ids.secondary)
    ) as new_total_sightings
  from ids
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'primary_pk_catalog_id', ids.primary,
  'secondary_pk_catalog_id', ids.secondary,
  'photos_moved', counts.photos_moved,
  'mantas_moved', counts.mantas_moved,
  'photos_via_mantas_moved', counts.photos_via_mantas_moved,
  'would_delete_secondary',
     (p_delete_secondary_if_detached
       and counts.photos_moved = 0
       and counts.mantas_moved = 0),
  'new_first_sighting', counts.new_first_sighting,
  'new_last_sighting',  counts.new_last_sighting,
  'new_total_sightings', counts.new_total_sightings
)
from ids, counts;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_imports_groundtruth_catalog(p_checks text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(field text, formula text, total_rows integer, matches integer, mismatches integer, null_in_csv integer, missing_dependencies boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
with s as (
  select
    pk_catalog_id,
    fn_parse_catalog_date(date_first_sighted) as d_first,
    fn_parse_catalog_date(date_last_sighted)  as d_last,
    nullif(regexp_replace(coalesce(days_between_first_last_sighting, days_between_first_last, '')::text, '[^0-9\.\-]', '', 'g'),'')::numeric as v_between,
    nullif(regexp_replace(coalesce(days_since_last_sighting, days_since_last_sighitng, '')::text, '[^0-9\.\-]', '', 'g'),'')::numeric as v_since
  from public.stg_catalog
),
chk as (
  -- Between (days)
  select
    'days_between_first_last:days'::text as field,
    '(date_last_sighted - date_first_sighted)::int'::text as formula,
    count(*) filter (where d_first is not null and d_last is not null) as total_rows,
    count(*) filter (where d_first is not null and d_last is not null and v_between is not null and (d_last - d_first) = v_between::int) as matches,
    count(*) filter (where d_first is not null and d_last is not null and v_between is not null and (d_last - d_first) <> v_between::int) as mismatches,
    count(*) filter (where v_between is null) as null_in_csv,
    false as missing_dependencies
  from s
  union all
  -- Between (years) tolerance 0.02y (~7.3 days)
  select
    'days_between_first_last:years'::text,
    '(date_last_sighted - date_first_sighted)/365.25'::text,
    count(*) filter (where d_first is not null and d_last is not null),
    count(*) filter (where d_first is not null and d_last is not null and v_between is not null
                     and abs(((d_last - d_first)/365.25) - v_between::numeric) <= 0.02),
    count(*) filter (where d_first is not null and d_last is not null and v_between is not null
                     and abs(((d_last - d_first)/365.25) - v_between::numeric) > 0.02),
    count(*) filter (where v_between is null),
    false
  from s
  union all
  -- Since last sighting (days)
  select
    'days_since_last_sighting'::text,
    '(current_date - date_last_sighted)::int'::text,
    count(*) filter (where d_last is not null),
    count(*) filter (where d_last is not null and v_since is not null and (current_date - d_last) = v_since::int),
    count(*) filter (where d_last is not null and v_since is not null and (current_date - d_last) <> v_since::int),
    count(*) filter (where v_since is null),
    false
  from s
  union all
  -- Placeholders needing cross-table joins (flag as missing deps)
  select 'last_sex'::text, 'latest s.gender by date'::text, 0,0,0,0,true
  union all
  select 'last_size'::text, 'latest size measurement'::text, 0,0,0,0,true
  union all
  select 'list_years_sighted'::text, 'distinct years from sightings'::text, 0,0,0,0,true
  union all
  select 'total_sightings'::text, 'count sightings per catalog'::text, 0,0,0,0,true
)
select *
from chk
where p_checks is null
   or split_part(field, ':', 1) = any (p_checks);
$function$

  returning id into v_log_id;

  with staged as (
    select
      s.pk_sighting_id,
      public.fn_parse_date_loose(s.sighting_date)::date as sdate, -- staged date parsed (NULL if blank/bad)
      nullif(btrim(s.island), '')        as island,

    returning 1

  set finished_at = now(),
      status      = 'committed_sightings_updates_only',

  returning id into v_log_id;

    from public.mantas
    where fk_catalog_id is not null and fk_sighting_id is not null
    group by 1,2
    having count(*) > 1

    select
      pk_manta_id                              as s_pk_manta_id,

      b.pk_manta_id,
      b.fk_catalog_id,
      b.fk_sighting_id,
      s.s_gender, s.s_age_class, s.s_photographer,

      (case when s.s_gender       is not null and lower(s.s_gender)       = lower(b.gender)       then 1 else 0 end) +
      (case when s.s_age_class    is not null and lower(s.s_age_class)    = lower(b.age_class)    then 1 else 0 end) +
      (case when s.s_photographer is not null and lower(s.s_photographer) = lower(b.photographer) then 1 else 0 end)
      as score
    from public.mantas b
    join amb a
      on a.fk_catalog_id = b.fk_catalog_id
     and a.fk_sighting_id = b.fk_sighting_id
    join s
      on b.fk_catalog_id  = s.s_fk_catalog_id
     and b.fk_sighting_id = s.s_fk_sighting_id
  ),
  best as ( -- pick one base row per ambiguous pair
    select *
    from (
      select
        cand.*,
        row_number() over (
          partition by fk_catalog_id, fk_sighting_id
          order by score desc, pk_manta_id asc
        ) as rn
      from cand
    ) x
    where x.rn = 1
  ),
  u as (
    update public.mantas base
       set
         -- NEVER overwrite existing non-NULL fk_catalog_id
         fk_catalog_id     = coalesce(base.fk_catalog_id,  best.fk_catalog_id),
         fk_sighting_id    = coalesce(best.fk_sighting_id, base.fk_sighting_id),

         -- text fields
         gender            = coalesce(best.s_gender,        base.gender),
         age_class         = coalesce(best.s_age_class,     base.age_class),
         photographer      = coalesce(best.s_photographer,  base.photographer),

         -- numeric fields
         size_m            = coalesce(best.s_size_m,             base.size_m),
         estimated_size_m  = coalesce(best.s_estimated_size_m,   base.estimated_size_m),
         total_biopsies    = coalesce(best.s_total_biopsies,     base.total_biopsies),
         total_tags        = coalesce(best.s_total_tags,         base.total_tags),

         updated_at        = now()
    from best
    where base.pk_manta_id = best.pk_manta_id
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_upd from u;

  update public.import_logs
     set status      = 'committed_mantas_by_pair_disambiguate',
         message     = 'mantas ambiguous pairs updates-only',
         finished_at = now()
   where id = v_log;

  return json_build_object(
    'updated_mantas', v_upd,
    'log_id',         v_log,
    'protected_fk_catalog_id', true
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_imports_commit_photos(p_src_file text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_allow_insert boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(rows_staged integer, rows_updated integer, rows_inserted integer, rows_skipped integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  v_staged int := 0;
  v_upd    int := 0;
  v_ins    int := 0;
  v_skip   int := 0;
begin
  -- Normalize a working subset from staging
  create temp table tmp_photos_commit as
  select
    public.fn_to_int(s.pk_photo_id)       as pk_photo_id,
    public.fn_to_int(s.fk_manta_id)       as fk_manta_id,
    public.fn_photo_clean_filename(s.file_name2) as file_name2_norm,
    public.fn_photo_view_norm(s.photo_view)      as photo_view_norm
  from public.stg_photos s
  where (p_src_file is null or s.src_file = p_src_file)
    and public.fn_is_image_filename(public.fn_photo_clean_filename(s.file_name2)) is true;

  get diagnostics v_staged = row_count;

  -- Updates by primary key (FK protection; do not touch "best" flags)
  with u as (
    update public.photos p
    set
      -- update filename only if normalized value is new and not used by another row
      file_name2 = case
        when tmp.file_name2_norm is not null
         and p.file_name2 is distinct from tmp.file_name2_norm
         and not exists (
           select 1 from public.photos p2
           where p2.file_name2 = tmp.file_name2_norm
             and p2.pk_photo_id <> p.pk_photo_id
         )
        then tmp.file_name2_norm
        else p.file_name2
      end,
      -- only set view if we have a clean value
      photo_view = coalesce(tmp.photo_view_norm, p.photo_view),
      -- FK protection: never overwrite a non-NULL existing FK
      fk_manta_id = case
        when tmp.fk_manta_id is not null and p.fk_manta_id is null then tmp.fk_manta_id
        else p.fk_manta_id
      end
    from tmp_photos_commit tmp
    where p.pk_photo_id = tmp.pk_photo_id
    returning p.pk_photo_id
  )
  select count(*) into v_upd from u;

  -- Optional inserts (off by default)
  if p_allow_insert then
    insert into public.photos (fk_manta_id, file_name2, photo_view)
    select
      tmp.fk_manta_id,
      tmp.file_name2_norm,
      tmp.photo_view_norm
    from tmp_photos_commit tmp
    left join public.photos p on p.pk_photo_id = tmp.pk_photo_id
    where (tmp.pk_photo_id is null or p.pk_photo_id is null)
      and tmp.file_name2_norm is not null
      and not exists (select 1 from public.photos p2 where p2.file_name2 = tmp.file_name2_norm);

    get diagnostics v_ins = row_count;
  end if;

  v_skip := coalesce(v_staged,0) - coalesce(v_upd,0) - coalesce(v_ins,0);

  -- Minimal import log
  create table if not exists public.import_logs (
    id bigserial primary key,
    target_table text not null,
    src_file text,
    started_at timestamptz default now(),
    finished_at timestamptz default now(),
    rows_staged int,
    rows_inserted int,
    rows_updated int,
    rows_skipped int,
    details jsonb
  );

  insert into public.import_logs(
    target_table, src_file, rows_staged, rows_inserted, rows_updated, rows_skipped, details
  )
  values (
    'photos', p_src_file, v_staged, v_ins, v_upd, v_skip,
    jsonb_build_object('commit','fn_imports_commit_photos','allow_insert',p_allow_insert)
  );

  return query select coalesce(v_staged,0), coalesce(v_upd,0), coalesce(v_ins,0), coalesce(v_skip,0);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_imports_commit_manta_sizes(p_src_file text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(rows_staged integer, rows_inserted integer, rows_skipped integer, rows_bad integer, rows_missing_fk integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  v_staged int := 0;
  v_ins    int := 0;
  v_bad    int := 0;
  v_mfk    int := 0;
begin
  -- Working set: valid parsed rows only
  create temp table tmp_sizes2 as
  select
    e.fk_manta_id,
    e.measurement_type,
    e.size_m,
    e.measured_on,
    e.photo_code,
    e.quality_note,
    e.calibration_params,
    e.src_file,
    md5( coalesce(e.fk_manta_id::text,'')
       || '|' || coalesce(e.measurement_type,'')
       || '|' || coalesce(e.size_m::text,'')
       || '|' || coalesce(e.measured_on::text,'')
       || '|' || coalesce(e.photo_code,'')
       || '|' || coalesce(e.src_file,'') )        as row_sig
  from public.stg_v_sizes2_extract e
  where (p_src_file is null or e.src_file = p_src_file)
    and e.fk_manta_id is not null
    and e.size_m is not null
    and e.size_m > 0;

  get diagnostics v_staged = row_count;

  -- Count bad rows (for reporting)
  select count(*) into v_bad
  from public.stg_v_sizes2_bad_rows b
  where (p_src_file is null or b.src_file = p_src_file);

  -- Insert only when the manta exists; skip if FK missing
  with src as (
    select t.*
    from tmp_sizes2 t
    join public.mantas m on m.pk_manta_id = t.fk_manta_id
  ),
  ins as (
    insert into public.manta_sizes(
      fk_manta_id, measurement_type, size_m, measured_on,
      photo_code, quality_note, calibration_params, src_file, row_sig
    )
    select
      s.fk_manta_id, s.measurement_type, s.size_m, s.measured_on,
      s.photo_code, s.quality_note, s.calibration_params, s.src_file, s.row_sig
    from src s
    on conflict (row_sig) do nothing
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_ins from ins;

  -- Missing FK count (looked valid but manta not found)
  select count(*) into v_mfk
  from tmp_sizes2 t
  left join public.mantas m on m.pk_manta_id = t.fk_manta_id
  where m.pk_manta_id is null;

  -- Ensure import_logs columns exist (non-breaking)
  create table if not exists public.import_logs (id bigserial primary key);
  alter table public.import_logs
    add column if not exists target_table  text,
    add column if not exists src_file      text,
    add column if not exists started_at    timestamptz default now(),
    add column if not exists finished_at   timestamptz default now(),
    add column if not exists rows_staged   int,
    add column if not exists rows_inserted int,
    add column if not exists rows_updated  int,
    add column if not exists rows_skipped  int,
    add column if not exists details       jsonb;

  insert into public.import_logs(target_table, src_file, rows_staged, rows_inserted, rows_updated, rows_skipped, details)
  values ('manta_sizes', p_src_file, v_staged, v_ins, 0, greatest(v_staged - v_ins,0),
          jsonb_build_object('commit','fn_imports_commit_manta_sizes','bad_rows',v_bad,'missing_fk',v_mfk));

  return query select v_staged, v_ins, greatest(v_staged - v_ins,0), v_bad, v_mfk;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_imports_commit_drone_surveys(p_batch uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_inserted int := 0;
  v_updated  int := 0;
  v_invalid  int := 0;
  v_skipped  int := 0;
begin
  -- Log invalids (missing/bad PK or bad date)
  insert into public.stg_import_errors(import_batch_id, target_table, source_file, row_no, reason_code, reason_detail, raw)
  select import_batch_id, 'drone_surveys', source_file, row_no,
         case when not has_pk then 'invalid_pk'
              when not survey_date_ok then 'invalid_date'
              else 'invalid_row' end as reason_code,
         case when not has_pk then 'pk_drone_survey not a UUID'
              when not survey_date_ok then 'survey_date parse failed'
              else 'row failed validation' end as reason_detail,
         raw
  from public.v_stg_drone_surveys_norm
  where import_batch_id = p_batch
    and not is_valid;

  get diagnostics v_invalid = row_count;

  -- De-duplicate within batch: keep first occurrence by row_no/id
  with dedup as (
    select *
    from public.v_stg_drone_surveys_norm
    where import_batch_id = p_batch
      and is_valid
      and dup_rank = 1
  ),
  up as (
    insert into public.drone_surveys as t (
      pk_drone_survey, survey_date, drone_pilot, population, island, region, location, notes
      -- If you have additional columns in drone_surveys (e.g., location_lat/lon),
      -- add them here and in the SELECT below. Keep the COALESCE logic in the UPSERT.
    )
    select
      d.pk_drone_survey,
      d.survey_date,
      d.drone_pilot,
      d.population,
      d.island,
      d.region,
      d.location,
      d.notes
    from dedup d
    on conflict (pk_drone_survey) do update
      set survey_date = coalesce(excluded.survey_date, t.survey_date),
          drone_pilot = coalesce(excluded.drone_pilot, t.drone_pilot),
          population  = coalesce(excluded.population,  t.population),
          island      = coalesce(excluded.island,      t.island),
          region      = coalesce(excluded.region,      t.region),
          location    = coalesce(excluded.location,    t.location),
          notes       = coalesce(excluded.notes,       t.notes)
    returning (xmax = 0) as inserted  -- inserted rows have xmax=0
  )
  select
    count(*) filter (where inserted) as ins,
    count(*) filter (where not inserted) as upd
  into v_inserted, v_updated
  from up;

  -- skipped = duplicates within batch that we ignored (dup_rank > 1)
  select count(*)
  into v_skipped
  from public.v_stg_drone_surveys_norm
  where import_batch_id = p_batch
    and is_valid
    and dup_rank > 1;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'batch', p_batch,
    'target', 'drone_surveys',
    'inserted', v_inserted,
    'updated', v_updated,
    'invalid', v_invalid,
    'skipped', v_skipped,
    'errors_table', 'stg_import_errors',
    'invalid_view', 'v_stg_invalid_drone_surveys'
  );
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_imports_commit_mprf_catalog(p_batch uuid, p_merge_gender boolean DEFAULT true, p_merge_age boolean DEFAULT true, p_merge_species boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_invalid int := 0;
  v_skip int := 0;
  v_upd int := 0;
  v_ins int := 0;
  v_chg_gender int := 0;
  v_chg_age int := 0;
  v_chg_species int := 0;
begin
  -- Log invalid rows
  insert into stg_import_errors(import_batch_id,target_table,source_file,row_no,reason_code,reason_detail,raw)
  select import_batch_id,'mprf_catalog',source_file,row_no,'invalid_row','name or pk_mprf_catalog_id missing',raw
  from v_stg_mprf_catalog_norm
  where import_batch_id = p_batch and not is_valid;
  get diagnostics v_invalid = row_count;

  -- Valid, deduped rows enriched with full species + normalized age and raw maturity code
  with d as (
    select
      n.*,
      case upper(n.species)
        when 'A' then 'mobula alfredi'
        when 'B' then 'mobula birostris'
        else n.species
      end as species_full,
      case
        when n.last_age_class in ('adult','juvenile','unknown') then n.last_age_class
        when upper(n.last_age_class) in ('M','MA','MC') then 'adult'
        when upper(n.last_age_class) = 'J' then 'juvenile'
        when upper(n.last_age_class) = 'U' then 'unknown'
        else n.last_age_class
      end as age_norm,
      (n.raw->>'MPRF_Current_Maturity') as maturity_code_raw
    from v_stg_mprf_catalog_norm n
    where n.import_batch_id = p_batch and n.is_valid and n.dup_rank = 1
  ),
  matched as (
    select
      c.pk_catalog_id,
      d.name,
      d.species_full,
      d.age_norm,
      d.last_gender,
      d.maturity_code_raw,
      d.species      as species_code,
      d.date_first_sighted as date_first_sighted_text,
      (p_merge_gender  and d.last_gender  is not null and d.last_gender  is distinct from c.last_gender)    as chg_gender,
      (p_merge_age     and d.age_norm     is not null and d.age_norm     is distinct from c.last_age_class) as chg_age,
      (p_merge_species and d.species_full is not null and d.species_full is distinct from c.species)        as chg_species
    from d
    left join catalog c on lower(c.name) = lower(d.name)
  ),
  updated as (
    update catalog c
       set last_gender    = case when m.chg_gender  then m.last_gender  else c.last_gender end,
           last_age_class = case when m.chg_age     then m.age_norm     else c.last_age_class end,
           species        = case when m.chg_species then m.species_full else c.species end,
           is_mprf        = true
      from matched m
     where c.pk_catalog_id = m.pk_catalog_id
       and (m.chg_gender or m.chg_age or m.chg_species or c.is_mprf is distinct from true)
    returning m.chg_gender, m.chg_age, m.chg_species
  )
  select
    count(*) as upd_ct,
    count(*) filter (where chg_gender)  as chg_gender_ct,
    count(*) filter (where chg_age)     as chg_age_ct,
    count(*) filter (where chg_species) as chg_species_ct
  into v_upd, v_chg_gender, v_chg_age, v_chg_species
  from updated;

  with d as (
    select
      *
    from v_stg_mprf_catalog_norm
    where import_batch_id = p_batch and is_valid and dup_rank = 1
  ),
  d2 as (
    select
      d.*,
      case upper(d.species)
        when 'A' then 'mobula alfredi'
        when 'B' then 'mobula birostris'
        else d.species
      end as species_full,
      case
        when d.last_age_class in ('adult','juvenile','unknown') then d.last_age_class
        when upper(d.last_age_class) in ('M','MA','MC') then 'adult'
        when upper(d.last_age_class) = 'J' then 'juvenile'
        when upper(d.last_age_class) = 'U' then 'unknown'
        else d.last_age_class
      end as age_norm
    from d
  ),
  to_insert as (
    select d2.*
    from d2
    left join catalog c on lower(c.name) = lower(d2.name)
    where c.pk_catalog_id is null
  ),
  ins as (
    insert into catalog (name, species, last_gender, last_age_class, is_mprf)
    select
      name,
      case when p_merge_species then species_full else null end,
      case when p_merge_gender  then last_gender  else null end,
      case when p_merge_age     then age_norm     else null end,
      true
    from to_insert
    on conflict (name) do update
      set species        = case when p_merge_species then coalesce(excluded.species,        catalog.species)        else catalog.species end,
          last_gender    = case when p_merge_gender  then coalesce(excluded.last_gender,    catalog.last_gender)    else catalog.last_gender end,
          last_age_class = case when p_merge_age     then coalesce(excluded.last_age_class, catalog.last_age_class) else catalog.last_age_class end,
          is_mprf        = true
    returning pk_catalog_id, name
  )
  select count(*) into v_ins from ins;

  -- Map + store raw codes for provenance
  insert into mprf_catalog_map(pk_mprf_catalog_id, pk_catalog_id, maturity_code, species_code, gender_code, date_first_sighted_text)
  select n.pk_mprf_catalog_id, c.pk_catalog_id,

    gender_code              = excluded.gender_code,

  return jsonb_build_object(

    'batch',p_batch,
    'invalid',v_invalid,
    'skipped',v_skip,
    'updated',v_upd,
    'inserted',v_ins,
    'overwrites', jsonb_build_object(
      'species', v_chg_species,
      'last_gender', v_chg_gender,
      'last_age_class', v_chg_age

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_imports_commit_mprf_sightings(p_batch uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_invalid int := 0;
  v_upserted int := 0;
  v_links int := 0;
begin
  -- 1) log invalid
  insert into stg_import_errors(import_batch_id,target_table,source_file,row_no,reason_code,reason_detail,raw)
  select import_batch_id,'mprf_sightings',source_file,row_no,'invalid_row','missing pk_mprf_sighting_id',raw
  from v_stg_mprf_sightings_norm
  where import_batch_id = p_batch and not is_valid;
  get diagnostics v_invalid = row_count;

  -- 2) upsert sightings ON CONFLICT (mprf_external_id)
  with d as (
    select * from v_stg_mprf_sightings_norm
    where import_batch_id = p_batch and is_valid and dup_rank=1
  ),
  up as (
    insert into sightings (mprf_external_id, sighting_date, location, island, region, population, is_mprf)
    select
      d.pk_mprf_sighting_id,
      try_cast_date(d.sighting_date),
      d.location,
      coalesce(d.island, 'Big Island'),
      coalesce(d.region, 'Kona'),
      'Big Island',
      true
    from d
    on conflict (mprf_external_id) do update
      set sighting_date = coalesce(try_cast_date(excluded.sighting_date::text), sightings.sighting_date),
          location      = coalesce(excluded.location,      sightings.location),
          island        = coalesce(excluded.island,        sightings.island),
          region        = coalesce(excluded.region,        sightings.region),
          population    = coalesce(excluded.population,    sightings.population),
          is_mprf       = true
    returning pk_sighting_id, mprf_external_id
  )
  select count(*) into v_upserted from up;

  -- 3) ensure external→internal mapping
  insert into mprf_sighting_map (pk_mprf_sighting_id, pk_sighting_id)
  select s.mprf_external_id, s.pk_sighting_id
  from sightings s
  where s.mprf_external_id is not null
  on conflict (pk_mprf_sighting_id) do update
    set pk_sighting_id = excluded.pk_sighting_id;

  -- 4) expand junction via MPRF list -> local catalog
  with d as (
    select * from v_stg_mprf_sightings_norm
    where import_batch_id = p_batch and is_valid and dup_rank=1
  ),
  explode as (
    select
      d.pk_mprf_sighting_id,
      trim(regexp_replace(x, '\s+', '', 'g')) as id_txt
    from d, regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(d.catalog_list,''), '[,;]') as x
    where nullif(btrim(x),'') is not null
  ),
  mapped as (
    select
      e.pk_mprf_sighting_id,
      (e.id_txt)::int as pk_mprf_catalog_id
    from explode e
    where e.id_txt ~ '^\d+$'
  ),
  join_map as (
    select
      m.pk_mprf_sighting_id,
      map.pk_catalog_id
    from mapped m
    join mprf_catalog_map map on map.pk_mprf_catalog_id = m.pk_mprf_catalog_id
  ),
  sids as (
    select sm.pk_mprf_sighting_id, sm.pk_sighting_id
    from mprf_sighting_map sm
    where sm.pk_mprf_sighting_id in (select pk_mprf_sighting_id from mapped)
  ),
  ins_links as (
    insert into sighting_catalog (fk_sighting_id, fk_catalog_id, is_mprf)
    select s.pk_sighting_id, j.pk_catalog_id, true
    from sids s
    join join_map j on j.pk_mprf_sighting_id = s.pk_mprf_sighting_id
    on conflict do nothing
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_links from ins_links;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'target','mprf_sightings',
    'batch',p_batch,
    'invalid',v_invalid,
    'upserted_sightings',v_upserted,
    'links_created',v_links
  );
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_imports_commit_mprf_mantas(p_batch uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_invalid   int := 0;
  v_upserts   int := 0;
  v_namefills int := 0;
begin
  -- Log invalid
  insert into stg_import_errors(import_batch_id,target_table,source_file,row_no,reason_code,reason_detail,raw)
  select import_batch_id,'mprf_mantas',source_file,row_no,'invalid_row','missing pk_mprf_manta_id or pk_mprf_catalog_id',raw
  from v_stg_mprf_mantas_norm
  where import_batch_id=p_batch and not is_valid;
  get diagnostics v_invalid = row_count;

  -- Valid, deduped by manta id
  with d as (
    select * from v_stg_mprf_mantas_norm
    where import_batch_id=p_batch and is_valid and dup_rank=1
  ),
  resolved as (
    select d.pk_mprf_manta_id,
           d.name,
           map.pk_catalog_id
    from d
    join mprf_catalog_map map on map.pk_mprf_catalog_id = d.pk_mprf_catalog_id
  ),
  up as (
    insert into mantas (mprf_external_manta_id, fk_catalog_id, name, is_mprf)
    select r.pk_mprf_manta_id, r.pk_catalog_id, null, true
    from resolved r
    on conflict (mprf_external_manta_id) do update
       set fk_catalog_id = coalesce(excluded.fk_catalog_id, mantas.fk_catalog_id),
           -- fill name only if currently null
           name         = coalesce(mantas.name, excluded.name),
           is_mprf      = true
    returning pk_manta_id, mprf_external_manta_id
  )
  select count(*) into v_upserts from up;

  -- Map external -> local id
  insert into mprf_manta_map(pk_mprf_manta_id, pk_manta_id)
  select mprf_external_manta_id, pk_manta_id
  from mantas
  where mprf_external_manta_id is not null
  on conflict (pk_mprf_manta_id) do update
    set pk_manta_id = excluded.pk_manta_id;

  -- Optional: fill names from staging where mantas.name is NULL
  with d as (
    select * from v_stg_mprf_mantas_norm
    where import_batch_id=p_batch and is_valid and dup_rank=1
  ),
  name_src as (
    select d.pk_mprf_manta_id, d.name
    from d
    where d.name is not null
  )
  update mantas m
     set name = n.name
    from name_src n
   where m.mprf_external_manta_id = n.pk_mprf_manta_id
     and m.is_mprf is true
     and m.name is null;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_namefills = ROW_COUNT;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'target','mprf_mantas',
    'batch',p_batch,
    'invalid',v_invalid,
    'upserted',v_upserts,
    'names_filled',v_namefills
  );
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_exemplars_aggregate_v2(query_embedding real[], exemplar_k integer DEFAULT 2000, catalog_k integer DEFAULT 200, exclude_pk_photo_id integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, probes integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(pk_catalog_id integer, score double precision, best_pk_photo_id integer, best_photo_url text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  execute format('set local ivfflat.probes = %s', probes);

  return query
  with top_exemplars as (
    select
      e.fk_catalog_id as catalog_id_int,
      e.pk_photo_id as exemplar_pk_photo_id,
      e.photo_url as exemplar_photo_url,
      1 - (e.embedding <=> (query_embedding::vector)) as exemplar_score
    from public.catalog_exemplar_embeddings_v2 e
    where exclude_pk_photo_id is null or e.pk_photo_id <> exclude_pk_photo_id
    order by e.embedding <=> (query_embedding::vector)
    limit exemplar_k
  ),
  agg as (
    select
      t.catalog_id_int,
      max(t.exemplar_score) as best_score
    from top_exemplars t
    group by t.catalog_id_int
  ),
  best as (
    select distinct on (t.catalog_id_int)
      t.catalog_id_int,
      t.exemplar_score,
      t.exemplar_pk_photo_id,
      t.exemplar_photo_url
    from top_exemplars t
    join agg a
      on a.catalog_id_int = t.catalog_id_int
     and a.best_score = t.exemplar_score
    order by t.catalog_id_int, t.exemplar_score desc
  )
  select
    b.catalog_id_int as pk_catalog_id,
    b.exemplar_score as score,
    b.exemplar_pk_photo_id as best_pk_photo_id,
    b.exemplar_photo_url as best_photo_url
  from best b
  order by b.exemplar_score desc
  limit catalog_k;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_relationship_averages_split()
 RETURNS TABLE(source text, metric text, avg_value numeric, min_value integer, max_value integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
with sighting_counts as (
  select
    case when s.is_mprf then 'MPRF' else 'HAMER' end as source,
    s.pk_sighting_id,
    count(m.pk_manta_id)::int as manta_count
  from public.sightings s
  left join public.mantas m
    on m.fk_sighting_id = s.pk_sighting_id
  group by 1, 2
),
manta_counts as (
  select
    case when s.is_mprf then 'MPRF' else 'HAMER' end as source,
    m.pk_manta_id,
    count(p.pk_photo_id)::int as photo_count
  from public.mantas m
  left join public.sightings s
    on s.pk_sighting_id = m.fk_sighting_id
  left join public.photos p
    on p.fk_manta_id = m.pk_manta_id
  group by 1, 2
),
catalog_counts as (
  select
    case when s.is_mprf then 'MPRF' else 'HAMER' end as source,
    m.fk_catalog_id,
    count(distinct s.pk_sighting_id)::int as sighting_count
  from public.mantas m
  join public.sightings s
    on s.pk_sighting_id = m.fk_sighting_id
  where m.fk_catalog_id is not null
  group by 1, 2
)
select *
from (
  select
    source::text as source,
    'mantas_per_sighting'::text as metric,
    avg(manta_count)::numeric as avg_value,
    min(manta_count)::int as min_value,
    max(manta_count)::int as max_value
  from sighting_counts
  group by source

  union all

  select
    source::text as source,
    'photos_per_manta'::text as metric,
    avg(photo_count)::numeric as avg_value,
    min(photo_count)::int as min_value,
    max(photo_count)::int as max_value
  from manta_counts
  group by source

  union all

  select
    source::text as source,
    'sightings_per_catalog'::text as metric,
    avg(sighting_count)::numeric as avg_value,
    min(sighting_count)::int as min_value,
    max(sighting_count)::int as max_value
  from catalog_counts
  group by source
) t
order by t.source, t.metric;
$function$
